method: Broker symbol metadata (digits, point, tick size/value, contract size, volume min/max/step, trade mode, filling mode) re-read live during active market. Static-field stability: 40 re-reads across ~234 s. Hash per cycle during runtime; any drift blocks the engine (METADATA_DRIFT_BLOCKED).

price_derived_field.trade_tick_value: drifts with price (0.003% over window) — expected, price-derived, not metadata drift
price_derived_field.note: the per-cycle metadata hash includes trade_tick_value, which legitimately varies across processes; static fields show 0 variants

runtime_hash_note: variants driven solely by price-derived trade_tick_value; no static-field drift; drift-block rule active and never fired
blocking_rule: metadata change -> METADATA_DRIFT_BLOCKED, no strategy evaluation
